_comment: English body for prompt-case-email-draft. Sections keyed by Chinese heading; sources aligned by index.

sections.任务与输入:
Generate an email draft; add no facts beyond the input and control tone by parameter.
Inputs: Recipient role, factual points, tone, and prohibitions.
sections.提示词本体:
```text
Write an email. Recipient: {recipient}. Facts: {facts}. Tone: {tone}. Prohibited: adding information beyond the facts, promising unauthorised items, or using exaggerated marketing language. Output subject and body; mark uncertainties with [to confirm].
```

Replace {field} placeholders with the current inputs before running.
sections.预期输出形态: subject and body with explicit markers for uncertainties.
sections.检查点:
- Each factual sentence links to facts.
- No unauthorised promises.
- Tone matches {tone}.
sections.失败分支:
- Over-polite and verbose: shorten while keeping facts.
- New fact appears: remove it and mark [to confirm].
sections.出处与边界: This site has not tested the effect of this prompt. See the sources for the mechanism; changing model, version or input can change the result.
